snippet.title: Balloon Hater - Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST here - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3540880/Balloon_Hater/

Pop balloons, upgrade your weapons, and boost your rewards in this satisfying idle clicker! Choose from a variety of tools to burst balloons faster and automate your progress.
